kits.name: craft
kits.summary: Building blocks for finished-looking 3D games, all generated in code: a stage (sky, sun, fog, shadows, weather, moods), 39 painted surfaces, terrain and water, trees, rocks, plants and grass, 48 props, animated people and animals, player control with a camera, effects, HUD and sound. One import covers a whole game. Call list_blocks for every function and its options.

kits.name: procgen
kits.summary: The procedural generation core under the craft blocks, usable on its own in any engine: seeded random numbers and hashes, noise that gives the same value in JS and in shaders, a mesh builder (tiled UVs, merged parts, displacement, welding, LOD), a texture painter (39 generators, normal maps, mips) and recipes (seed + parameters as data).

kits.name: hud
kits.summary: Interface in plain DOM for any game, 2D or 3D: counters, bars, timer, objective, hints, toasts, prompts, buttons, a title screen and an end screen.

kits.name: sound
kits.summary: Sound with no audio files for any game: 28 effects, 10 looping ambiences and 8 generative music moods; unlocks on the first gesture.

kits.name: core
kits.summary: Seeded randomness, simplex noise, math helpers, a frame loop with clamped dt, a boot screen wired to GCP, quality picking, safe storage.

kits.name: input
kits.summary: Keyboard, mouse (with pointer lock), touch (virtual stick + buttons) and gamepad behind one object: move axis, look deltas, pressed/down, and named actions (input.bind) so one line of game code serves every device.

kits.name: three-kit
kits.summary: Three.js helpers: renderer setup with resize and context-loss handling, canvas-painted textures, material cache, merged vertex-colour meshes, lumpy organic shapes, instancing, gradient sky, a shadowed sun that follows the player, terrain geometry, disposal.

kits.name: craft2d
kits.summary: 2D and 2.5D worlds from small calls: createStage2d (camera, depth sorting, shadows, moods with darkness and lights, weather), ground2d (painted land from noise), sprite2d (30 painted kinds), scatter2d, actor2d (animated people and animals), control2d, wander2d.

kits.name: play
kits.summary: The systems under a game with depth, for 2D and 3D alike: createInventory (slots, stacks, hotbar, 32 painted item icons), createCrafting (recipes, stations), createNeeds (health, food, stamina or your own), createClock (day and night that drives the stage light), createNodes and createInteract (harvest any scattered tree or rock, with prompts), createBuilder (pieces on a grid), createQuests, createSave (cloud save with autosave); and their panels: hotbarUI, inventoryUI, needsUI, clockUI, questUI, minimapUI, pauseMenu, lobbyUI. Also exported by craft.js and craft2d.js.

kits.name: canvas2d
kits.summary: 2D canvas helpers: DPR-aware canvas, sprites baked once to offscreen canvases, a camera, y-sorted drawing, cached ground chunks.

kits.name: audio
kits.summary: Synthesised sound with no audio files: tones, noise bursts, mute, automatic unlock on the first gesture.

kits.name: net
kits.summary: Host-authoritative multiplayer on GCP.room: the host simulates and broadcasts snapshots, guests send inputs; includes snapshot interpolation.
